description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.
The token for the next query.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh: 资源类型定义。固定取值：ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE
description.en: The resource type. Fixed value: ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE.

title.zh: 查询指定标签键对应的标签值
title.en: Query tag values of a specified tag key

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi list-tag-values --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --resource-type ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-lbj0000x10g --key demoKey --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aekzwwk0000cv5i --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ListTagValues --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzwwk0000cv5i' --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --InstanceId 'waf_v2_public_cn-lbj0000x10g' --ResourceType 'ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Key demoKey
